_meta.note: This module's own texts. The host reads this file from locales/en.json beside the bundle's entry and merges it under the module's namespace. Copy it to <tag>.json to translate; a key you leave out falls back to the line here.
error.threemf/INVALID_QUERY: The request could not be read
error.threemf/NOT_A_PROJECT: That file is not a 3MF project the module can read
error.threemf/NO_FILE: The storage does not hold that file
error.threemf/NO_OBJECT: That 3MF project has no such object
error.threemf/NO_THUMBNAIL: That 3MF project has no such picture
error.threemf/PROJECT_TOO_LARGE: That 3MF project is larger than the module reads
error.threemf/READ_FAILED: The project could not be read just now. Try again in a moment
projectView.bed.name: Bed {number}
projectView.bed.picture: The picture the slicer saved of {bed}
projectView.beds.gcodeOnly: The slicer stored G-code for this bed. No object is left to slice.
projectView.beds.parked: Every copy on this bed is left out of the print, so the bed holds parked parts and no print.
projectView.browser.heading: Beds and objects
projectView.changes.heading: Changes by height
projectView.copy.approx: The outline is the box around the mesh, because the mesh is too large to keep.
projectView.copy.label: {name}, copy {number} of {count}
projectView.extruder.title: {tool}, {type}
projectView.failed.heading: The project could not be read
projectView.failed.reference: The page did not name a file of a storage.
projectView.gcodeOnly.description: This file holds G-code for {count, plural, one {1 bed} other {# beds}} and no objects. It prints as it is and cannot be sliced again.
projectView.gcodeOnly.heading: Sliced G-code only
projectView.issue.gcode_only: The file holds G-code and no objects.
projectView.issue.outline_approx: A mesh is too large to keep, so its copies are drawn from the box around it.
projectView.issue.settings_unreadable: A settings file in the project could not be read: {detail}. The setup shows what the model says.
projectView.issue.thumbnail_unreadable: A picture in the project could not be read: {detail}.
projectView.issue.unknown_reference: The file names an object it does not hold. That part of the file is left out.
projectView.issue.unsupported_extension: The model needs the 3MF extension {detail}, which this server does not read. Shapes and beds may be wrong.
projectView.issue.unsupported_producer: {detail} is not a slicer this server supports. Its project is read like an OrcaSlicer one, so the beds and settings may be incomplete.
projectView.issues.summary: {count, plural, one {1 part of this file could not be read in full} other {# parts of this file could not be read in full}}
projectView.overview.heading: Project
projectView.overview.outside: {count, plural, one {1 copy off its bed} other {# copies off their beds}}
projectView.overview.parked: {count, plural, one {1 copy left out of the print} other {# copies left out of the print}}
projectView.overview.picture: The picture the slicer saved of the project
projectView.panel.meshBox: The mesh is too large for the server to keep, so each part is drawn as the box around it.
projectView.panel.meshFailed: The shape of this object could not be read, so it is shown from above.
projectView.panel.meshHint: Drag to turn it, scroll or pinch to zoom.
projectView.panel.meshSimplified: Made simpler to draw. The file has {count, plural, one {1 triangle} other {# triangles}}.
projectView.panel.solid: {name} in 3D. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom. The arrow keys turn it and 0 brings back the first view.
projectView.plan.drawing: Plan of the beds, to scale. Each shape is one copy of an object, seen from above.
projectView.plan.hint: Press a copy to tick it. Press it twice to open its object. The arrow keys move between copies.
projectView.plan.hintOpen: Press a copy to open its object. The arrow keys move between copies.
projectView.plan.offDrawing: The copies on no bed, seen from above. They are not printed.
projectView.plan.unknownSize: The file does not give the size of this bed. It is drawn around what stands on it.
projectView.ranges.heading: Layer ranges
projectView.selection.idle: Tick objects in the list, or press copies on the plan, to choose what to print.
projectView.selection.label: {copies, plural, one {1 copy} other {# copies}} of {objects, plural, one {1 object} other {# objects}} ticked
projectView.settings.heading: Settings
projectView.settings.none: The file holds no slicer settings. A plain 3MF file carries the models alone.
